sources.said: Wednesday : ... Labor Day - Memorial Day 7:30 PM Spanish

slots.rationale: R1 prints it weekly in both bulletins, and both weeks' intentions list a 7:30 p.m. Wednesday Mass; but the website, whose Mass times otherwise match the bulletin exactly, limits it to Labor Day - Memorial Day. The format cannot express movable holiday bounds (R33), so September-May is an approximation off by a few days at each end; leaning to it since year-round would be wrong all summer. Update mode will see the summer bulletins.
slots.question: Wednesday 7:30 PM Spanish Mass: the bulletin lists it with no season, the website says Labor Day - Memorial Day. Record it with a September-May season?
